Task 2: Describe the future of asteroid mining and its impact on equity
Task 3: Explain the channels, and how changed conditions affect equity

contributions.summary: Unweighted Theil rejected because it calls the world fair only when the United States and the Vatican are equal.
Cooperation is privately rational; the one-line 'Is this the end?' then shows it widens the outsider gap.
Scaled Shapley weights 0.6437 and 0.5982 at heat-map cell (30, 30).
Path coefficients 0.45, 0.38, 0.29 through GDP, trade, and income per capita.

dependency_graph.handoff: National-power scores and the corrected Theil index are recomputed after the Lucky GDP shock
Factor-score formula is re-evaluated at the new GDP, then the Theil index is recomputed after Shapley allocation
The cooperation result motivates the multi-country Shapley game; monopoly relapse returns to the oligopoly

assumptions.summary: Mining-capable countries stay fixed for a short period.
Cooperation is stable and nobody interferes on purpose.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Twelve indicators, eight countries, World Bank and Knoema, standardized by sample standard deviation. Factor analysis in SAS.

models.summary: NPT: population-weighted, log-corrected Theil index of a three-factor national-power score.
OCG: cooperative-competition profit beats Nash; Lucky +15 percent GDP spikes the between-group Theil index.
SHP: Monte Carlo Shapley allocation plus path analysis under Lucky3.

verification.summary: A-grade with D-grade produces a large Theil index, treated as agreement with reality.
C-rank indicators shifted by 5 percent; Theil index moves, so the index is called sensitive.

results_trace.summary: Three factors exceed 80 percent of variance. Printed 2017 scores include United States 0.953 and China 0.452, with rows visibly shifted.
Lucky in 2005 raises one capable country's GDP by 15 percent; the mining-versus-non-mining Theil curve jumps.
Heat-map peak at row 30, column 30. Scaled Shapley values 0.6437 and 0.5982. Theil index falls after allocation.
Lucky3 adds 0.05 to every indicator. Path coefficients 0.45, 0.38, 0.29.
Brazil mirrored to French growth, 1870-1897: Theil index falls, then rebounds.

writing_logic.summary: Summary answers one problem per paragraph, each opening 'For Problem N'.
Literature review is a chain of 'which provided us with' and 'which let us', closed by 'however, there are few studies'.
A definition is extended, then destroyed by a reductio, then replaced. The replacement is motivated before it is written.
Private conclusion, one-line question, then the outsider's question. The pivot is a sentence by itself.
Policy is not a list. Each UN Charter clause is quoted, then answered.

language_observations.summary: Opens on a dilemma question: stepping stone or devil. The rest of the paragraph earns the right to analyze.
'It is just so obviously inconsistent with reality' plus the Vatican reductio. Contempt is doing analytical work.
'The reason why ... is because' explains a formula's 1 before changing it.
Tautology 'each era has the characteristics of each era', then a real concession about judging slave societies by present standards, then the compression move.
'Is this the end?' alone on the line. Then 'but what about the rest of them?'
Churchill is drafted against speculators: 'trampling on the efforts of all mankind'.
'money for money, power for power' — a balanced colloquial pair where a formal paper would say 'comparative advantage'.
Clause, then metaphor: garden of Eden versus smoky battlefield. The metaphor is the policy's motive, not an ornament.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: Killing the naive index with a one-sentence reductio is more persuasive than fitting a fancier index immediately.
Separating the private gain from the outsider loss, with a one-line pivot, is the argument a policy judge can remember.
Quoting the preamble and answering clause by clause ties every policy to a text the reader already grants.

weaknesses.summary: Authors: the subject is highly unknown, so the model has a time limit and cannot predict every development.
Authors: Monte Carlo used several times, so generality is weak.
Eight countries and a shifted score table cannot support a world-equity claim at the printed precision.

independent_extensions.summary: State what row 30 and column 30 mean in contribution units, and report the search grid.
Replace the flat +0.05 Lucky3 lift with a shock scaled to mission value.

candidate_rule_impacts.summary: Decomposable inequality index, population-weighted, checked against Gini.
Policy written as answers to an existing charter, not as a free list.
